just_in.title: Assam Floods Kill 85 and Displace Over 700,000 in State's Worst Monsoon Crisis
just_in.excerpt: A cloudburst in Nagaland triggered devastating flooding across Upper Assam's Brahmaputra Valley, submerging nearly 900 villages and destroying 37,000 hectares of cropland.
just_in.image_caption: Floodwaters inundated villages across Upper Assam after heavy monsoon rainfall swelled the Brahmaputra and its tributaries beyond danger levels. Rescue operations evacuated thousands from submerged areas in Sivasagar and Charaideo districts.
just_in.nri_angle: The floods have devastated communities in Assam with deep ties to the diaspora, prompting relief campaigns from Indian-Americans and raising questions about the pace of flood-control infrastructure investment in the Northeast.

just_in.title: Praggnanandhaa Wins Saint Louis Rapid and Blitz, Surges to Second in Grand Chess Tour
just_in.excerpt: The 21-year-old Indian grandmaster dominated the field with 23½ points, finishing 1½ points clear of nearest rival Javokhir Sindarov and climbing within half a point of tour leader Fabiano Caruana.
just_in.image_caption: R Praggnanandhaa scored 23½ points to win the 2026 Saint Louis Rapid and Blitz at the Saint Louis Chess Club. The 21-year-old Indian grandmaster dominated the five-day tournament from start to finish.
just_in.nri_angle: Praggnanandhaa's dominant victory in St. Louis continues India's golden era in chess, following Gukesh's world championship win and a wave of young Indian grandmasters reshaping the global game.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Ladakh to Launch India's First High-Altitude Wildlife Safari on Snow Leopard Trails
just_in.excerpt: The newly constituted SHAN Conservation Society has directed forest officials to introduce guided jeep safaris across Hemis National Park and other protected areas, modeled on Kaziranga and Ranthambore.
just_in.image_caption: Ladakh is home to 477 of India's estimated 718 snow leopards and will introduce guided jeep safaris across its high-altitude wildlife trails. The initiative aims to curb illegal off-roading while creating sustainable livelihoods for local communities.
just_in.nri_angle: Ladakh's new safari program offers diaspora travelers a structured way to experience India's Himalayan wildlife, adding to the territory's appeal as a bucket-list destination for Indian-Americans and NRI adventurers.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Sweetgreen Cuts Full-Year Outlook as Cyclospora Outbreak Tanks Salad Demand
just_in.excerpt: The salad chain slashed its same-store sales forecast and warned of prolonged consumer hesitancy toward fresh produce, even though none of its ingredients have been linked to the nationwide illness.

food.excerpt: The western Indian state joins a national push to pull cheap vegetable-fat imitations off menus and store shelves, with over 2,500 eateries inspected and hundreds of kilograms of substandard food destroyed.
food.image_caption: Paneer, a staple of Indian cuisine, is at the centre of Gujarat's new food safety crackdown banning analogue dairy substitutes.
food.nri_angle: NRIs who regularly consume paneer should verify sourcing, especially unbranded loose products; the crackdown highlights a food safety gap in India that affects diaspora visits and imports.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: From ICRISAT Lab to Rs 2 Crore Business: The Indian Scientist Behind Edible Spoons
food.excerpt: Narayana Peesapaty quit crop research to build Bakeys, the Hyderabad startup making cutlery from jowar, rice and wheat that you eat after your meal or let decompose in days.
food.image_caption: Bakey's edible cutlery, invented by former ICRISAT scientist Narayana Peesapaty, offers a biodegradable alternative to single-use plastic.
food.nri_angle: The edible cutlery movement combines Indian scientific ingenuity with global sustainability goals, exemplifying the frugal innovation model India is increasingly exporting worldwide.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Global Food Prices Set to Surge as Iran War and El Niño Squeeze Supply Chains
food.excerpt: The FAO's chief economist warns that commodity prices will start climbing by year-end, with a full-blown food price spike likely in 2027 as the Strait of Hormuz closure drives up energy and fertilizer costs.
food.nri_angle: India's dependence on imported edible oils and fertilizers means rising global food costs directly pressure domestic inflation and reduce the purchasing power of remittances.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: India Ranks 13th Among World's Best Cuisines in TasteAtlas Awards
food.excerpt: Butter garlic naan and Amritsari kulcha lead Indian entries, with Mumbai named among the world's top five food cities in the annual global food rankings.
food.nri_angle: The TasteAtlas ranking validates Indian cuisine's global standing, resonating with diaspora communities who have long championed their food traditions abroad.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Singhara Flour Cheela: The Fasting-Friendly Pancake Worth Making Year-Round
food.excerpt: This crisp, protein-rich water chestnut flour pancake is a staple of Sawan Somwar fasting—and a gluten-free option that deserves a permanent place in the kitchen.
food.image_caption: Singhara flour cheela, a crispy water chestnut flour pancake popular during Indian fasting days, can be enjoyed year-round as a nutritious snack.
food.nri_angle: Singhara flour cheela connects diaspora families to Indian fasting traditions during Sawan, making observance possible with ingredients available through online Indian grocery retailers.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Mumbai, Delhi and Jaipur Ranked Among World's Best Street Food Cities
food.excerpt: Top chefs endorse global rankings as Mumbai's khau gallis and Delhi's Mughlai lanes earn international recognition from Time Out and TasteAtlas.
food.nri_angle: Street food serves as a visceral connection to home for the diaspora; international validation may spur more Indian street food concepts abroad.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Maharashtra Bans Analogue Paneer for One Year, Violators Face Jail Time
food.excerpt: The state escalates from mandatory disclosure to an outright prohibition on fake paneer in all hotels and restaurants, with penalties including six months imprisonment.
food.nri_angle: NRI visitors and the diaspora frequently consume paneer dishes when traveling to India; the ban ensures they receive genuine dairy products at restaurants.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Biryani King Brings Punjabi Soul Food to Honolulu's Sheridan Street
food.excerpt: A Pakistani-born chef's home-style cooking — from charcoal tandoor naan to oxtail biryani — is winning over Hawaiʻi's food scene and its desi community.
food.image_caption: Biryani King, a new Punjabi restaurant on Honolulu's Sheridan Street, specialises in home-style biryani and North Indian cuisine
food.nri_angle: A Pakistani Punjabi immigrant chef brings home-style cooking to Honolulu, filling a gap for the city's South Asian community
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Bengaluru's Legendary MTR Is Opening in Sydney, Bringing Its Century-Old Dosas to Australia
food.excerpt: Australia's assistant minister for multicultural affairs confirmed the 102-year-old Mavalli Tiffin Rooms will franchise in Sydney, adding to a growing list of international outposts.
food.image_caption: MTR (Mavalli Tiffin Rooms), credited with inventing the rava idli, is opening a franchise in Sydney
food.nri_angle: MTR's expansion to Sydney is a landmark moment for the large Indian-Australian community, many of whom have roots in South India and nostalgia for the restaurant's iconic dishes.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Hyderabad Police Seize 25,000 Kg of Adulterated Spices Laced With Industrial Dyes
food.excerpt: Raids on 13 spice processing units uncover fabric dye, synthetic colours, and talcum powder being used to make low-quality spices appear premium, part of a 140-day crackdown that has seized 246 tonnes of suspect food products.
food.image_caption: Hyderabad police seized 25,000 kilograms of adulterated spices laced with industrial dyes in a crackdown on food safety violations.
food.nri_angle: Indian spices are widely exported and sold globally. Adulteration in the supply chain raises questions about quality reaching diaspora consumers from London to Toronto to Sydney.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Ladakh to Launch India's First High-Altitude Wildlife Safari on Snow Leopard Trails
travel.excerpt: The newly constituted SHAN Conservation Society has directed forest officials to introduce guided jeep safaris across Hemis National Park and other protected areas, modeled on Kaziranga and Ranthambore.
travel.image_caption: Ladakh is home to 477 of India's estimated 718 snow leopards and will introduce guided jeep safaris across its high-altitude wildlife trails. The initiative aims to curb illegal off-roading while creating sustainable livelihoods for local communities.
travel.nri_angle: Ladakh's new safari program offers diaspora travelers a structured way to experience India's Himalayan wildlife, adding to the territory's appeal as a bucket-list destination for Indian-Americans and NRI adventurers.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Iberia to Chase the Solar Eclipse at 35,000 Feet in a Historic First
travel.excerpt: The Spanish airline will fly an Airbus A321XLR above the clouds on August 12 to observe Spain's first total solar eclipse in over a century, livestreaming the event globally via Starlink.
travel.image_caption: An Iberia aircraft. The Spanish flag carrier is planning a special flight to chase the solar eclipse at 35,000 feet.
travel.nri_angle: For the Indian diaspora in Europe, the eclipse offers a rare celestial spectacle visible from Spain, with Valencia, Zaragoza, and Barcelona all in the path of totality — an experience not seen from the Iberian Peninsula since 1912.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: EVA Air to Launch Nonstop Taipei–Delhi Flights in December, Targeting India-US Transit Market
travel.excerpt: Taiwan's second-largest carrier plans to connect Delhi to its North American network of 10 cities, offering one-stop routes for Indian tech professionals heading to Silicon Valley.
travel.nri_angle: The new Taipei-Delhi route gives NRIs in the US, especially tech workers on the West Coast, a Pacific routing alternative for trips home.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Air India Names Ethiopian Airlines Veteran Tewolde Gebremariam as New CEO
travel.excerpt: The Tata-owned carrier appoints the architect of Ethiopian Airlines' rise as Africa's largest carrier to lead its turnaround following a fatal 2025 crash and record losses exceeding $2 billion.
travel.nri_angle: For the millions of NRIs who rely on Air India for long-haul flights between India and destinations across North America, Europe, and the Gulf, the new CEO's turnaround track record could determine whether the carrier's service, safety, and reliability finally match its expansion ambitions.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Jetstar to Charge Passengers for Overhead Locker Access Starting February 2027
travel.excerpt: Qantas's budget subsidiary will require travelers to purchase a Priority Carry-on add-on to stow bags in overhead bins, joining a global shift toward unbundled airfares.
travel.image_caption: Jetstar Airways will begin charging passengers for overhead locker access on select routes starting February 2027.
travel.nri_angle: Jetstar operates key routes between Australia and Southeast Asia used heavily by the Indian diaspora, and the carry-on fee will affect budget-conscious travelers on these corridors.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Ranthambore Safari Bookings Crash as Record Demand Overwhelms New Portal
travel.excerpt: Rajasthan's revamped booking website for India's most popular tiger reserve buckled under massive traffic as the October–December season opened, highlighting surging wildlife tourism demand.
travel.nri_angle: NRIs and international tourists planning India wildlife trips face the same booking gridlock, with the new portal requiring passport uploads and foreign cards often failing on Indian payment gateways.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Trump Signs New Executive Orders to Restrict Birthright Citizenship After Supreme Court Rebuke
carousel.excerpt: The president's narrower approach targets 'birth tourism' and children of 'alien enemies,' weeks after the court struck down his broader ban as unconstitutional.
carousel.nri_angle: Indian Americans on H-1B and other temporary visas whose U.S.-born children hold automatic citizenship could face uncertainty as the administration tests new limits on birthright protections.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Assam Floods Kill 85 and Displace Over 700,000 in State's Worst Monsoon Crisis
carousel.excerpt: A cloudburst in Nagaland triggered devastating flooding across Upper Assam's Brahmaputra Valley, submerging nearly 900 villages and destroying 37,000 hectares of cropland.
carousel.image_caption: Floodwaters inundated villages across Upper Assam after heavy monsoon rainfall swelled the Brahmaputra and its tributaries beyond danger levels. Rescue operations evacuated thousands from submerged areas in Sivasagar and Charaideo districts.
carousel.nri_angle: The floods have devastated communities in Assam with deep ties to the diaspora, prompting relief campaigns from Indian-Americans and raising questions about the pace of flood-control infrastructure investment in the Northeast.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Priyanka Chopra Jonas and Russell Crowe to Star in Sci-Fi Thriller Bluefly
carousel.excerpt: The first-time pairing will headline a black-ops Congo thriller directed by Predators filmmaker Nimród Antal, shooting on Australia's Gold Coast later this year.
carousel.image_caption: Priyanka Chopra Jonas, who will star alongside Russell Crowe in the upcoming sci-fi thriller Bluefly, set to film on Australia's Gold Coast.
carousel.nri_angle: Priyanka Chopra Jonas continues to expand her Hollywood portfolio, adding a major sci-fi role opposite an Oscar winner while simultaneously working on SS Rajamouli's epic Varanasi.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Praggnanandhaa Wins Saint Louis Rapid and Blitz, Surges to Second in Grand Chess Tour
carousel.excerpt: The 21-year-old Indian grandmaster dominated the field with 23½ points, finishing 1½ points clear of nearest rival Javokhir Sindarov and climbing within half a point of tour leader Fabiano Caruana.
carousel.image_caption: R Praggnanandhaa scored 23½ points to win the 2026 Saint Louis Rapid and Blitz at the Saint Louis Chess Club. The 21-year-old Indian grandmaster dominated the five-day tournament from start to finish.
carousel.nri_angle: Praggnanandhaa's dominant victory in St. Louis continues India's golden era in chess, following Gukesh's world championship win and a wave of young Indian grandmasters reshaping the global game.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Big Tech's AI Spending Binge Turns Cash Machines Into Cash Burners
carousel.excerpt: Alphabet's first-ever negative free cash flow and a fresh $25 billion bond sale signal a new era where the world's most profitable companies must borrow to fund the AI arms race.
carousel.nri_angle: The AI spending transformation raises questions for Indian-American tech workers and investors about the sustainability of Silicon Valley's biggest bet.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Wall Street Hits Records as Yen Intervention and Earnings Surge Reshape Markets
carousel.excerpt: The Dow and S&P 500 reached all-time highs on blockbuster corporate earnings, while a rare joint U.S.-Japan intervention to support the yen exposed the fragile currency dynamics underpinning the global rally.
carousel.nri_angle: Diaspora investors with U.S. and Asian market exposure face interconnected risks as currency dynamics and AI-driven earnings reshape global markets.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk
